description: 中央管排水 [stormwater and drainage] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 資料來源為經濟部水利署水利規劃試驗所99年「中央管區域排水GIS系統建置及資料之統計分析」，所統整中央管區域排水系統資料，併同補充蒐集資料及現場調查資料進行數化建置之圖資。 本資料庫含公告之36條中央管區域排水，排水名稱如下：深澳坑溪排水、大內坑溪排水、塔寮坑溪排水、鶯歌溪(兔子坑溪)排水、福興溪排水、伯公岡支線、六股溪排水、德盛溪排水... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
